seoTitle: Free Cookie and Set-Cookie Header Parser
metaDescription: Split Cookie and Set-Cookie headers into names, decoded values and attributes. Free, offline, JSON output available.
intro: Parses a Cookie request header into its name and value pairs, and Set-Cookie response headers into the name, value and attributes such as Path, Domain, Expires, Max-Age, Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite.
why:
A Cookie header is a single line of name=value pairs, and Set-Cookie lines carry attributes after semicolons. DevTools shows them in a table, but logs and curl output do not.

Paste the header lines and read each cookie on its own, with percent-encoded values decoded and Expires converted to an ISO date. This tool describes; it does not judge. For security findings use the Cookie Flag Analyzer. Cookie values can be session identifiers, so avoid sharing the page link with real ones.
howTo: Paste Cookie: and Set-Cookie: lines, or the bare header values.
Tick JSON if you want structured output.
Read the name, value and attributes for each cookie.

faq.q: Can I paste a header without the name?
faq.a: A line without Cookie: or Set-Cookie: is read as a Set-Cookie value.
Percent-encoded values are shown decoded when valid, to make them readable. The original text is unchanged elsewhere.
No. Use the Cookie Flag Analyzer for that.
